en.text: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! he rejoices in your salvation!

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，王必因你的能力欢喜；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，王必因你的能力歡喜；

en.text: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.

zhSimplified.text: 他心里所愿的，你已经赐给他；

zhTraditional.text: 他心裏所願的，你已經賜給他；

en.text: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 他向你求寿，你便赐给他，

zhTraditional.text: 他向你求壽，你便賜給他，

en.text: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

zhSimplified.text: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀；

zhTraditional.text: 他因你的救恩大有榮耀；

en.text: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

zhSimplified.text: 你使他有洪福，直到永远，

zhTraditional.text: 你使他有洪福，直到永遠，

en.text: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

zhSimplified.text: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敌；

zhTraditional.text: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敵；

en.text: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

zhSimplified.text: 你发怒的时候，要使他们如在炎热的火炉中。

zhTraditional.text: 你發怒的時候，要使他們如在炎熱的火爐中。

en.text: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

zhSimplified.text: 你必从世上灭绝他们的子孙，

zhTraditional.text: 你必從世上滅絕他們的子孫，

en.text: For they intended evil against you. you which cannot succeed.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们有意加害于你；

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們有意加害於你；

en.text: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，愿你因自己的能力显为至高！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，願你因自己的能力顯為至高！
